results.title: How do death rates in each age group contribute to the overall sex gap in life expectancy?
results.subtitle: The total height of the curve shows the total sex gap in life expectancy in years (female minus male). Positive values indicate higher life expectancy in females. The stacked areas show how the gap arises from sex differences in death rates in each age group.

results.title: Inequality in life expectancy
results.subtitle: The Atkinson index measures inequality on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher inequality. Inequality is measured here in terms of the number of years a newborn would live if age-specific mortality rates in the current year were to stay the same throughout its life.
availableEntities: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

results.title: Period versus cohort life expectancy
results.subtitle: Two different approaches to calculating life expectancy at birth are compared: period life expectancy (based on death rates in one particular year) and cohort life expectancy (based on average lifespans).

results.title: Healthy life expectancy and years lived with disability or disease
results.subtitle: The period life expectancy at birth, broken down by the estimated number of years lived in "full health" versus years lived with disability or disease burden.
